surfaced.body: 5121 (Conturi la bănci în lei), 5124 (Conturi la bănci în valută), 531 (Casa): cash and bank balances — RON 1,168,047; current liabilities — RON 13,012,977; cash cover of current liabilities — 0.09×. Basis: cash is measured against the company's own current liabilities for the same period, against the cash floor this structural profile is graded on. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations because no prior period was supplied; working-capital movements carry a wide band. (profile inventory_operator/band_mid/fin_related_party_funded resolved from structure).

surfaced.body: 601 (Cheltuieli cu materiile prime), 602 (Cheltuieli cu materialele consumabile), 607 (Cheltuieli privind mărfurile): turnover — RON 110,798,309; statutory EBITDA — RON 11,848,065; input cost as a share of turnover — 63.7%. Basis: input cost is measured against the company's own turnover for the same period, and the ceiling is the one this structural profile is graded on. Source: period p-saga_10_col_agras; snapshot doc-saga_10_col_agras; accounts 601, 602, 607; assembled_canonical_v1. Rule input_cost_exposure fires when input-cost share of revenue ceiling is above 35.0%; observed 63.7%. Impact: EBITDA margin, as reported versus with input cost at the ceiling this profile is graded on moves from 10.7% to 39.4% (+28.7%). Input cost is the largest single line a mid-size inventory-heavy operator carries, and it is repriced by suppliers faster than the company can reprice its own customers — the margin, not the volume, is what moves. Do this: 1) Negotiate index-linked price-review clauses into the largest supplier contracts — price-review clause covering the input lines behind 601 and 602, from the procurement lead (before the next annual price round). 2) Hedge the next two quarters of input volume — forward purchase cover schedule, by input line and delivery month, from the treasury team. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations because no prior period was supplied; working-capital movements carry a wide band. (profile inventory_operator/band_mid/fin_related_party_funded resolved from structure).
